confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors rest on general knowledge of Pai's small-town Thai tourist pricing and are the more reliable part. Cocktail and wine are bounded from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation anchors are less certain (low-medium) and assume July green-season, low-season rates including Thai VAT and service charges. FX: 0.6947 USD per AUD is the 16 October 2026 observation as reported on the RBA exchange rates page and corroborated by a third-party site citing the RBA. I did not open the RBA page directly, so the value should be confirmed against the official F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on small backpacker-oriented towns in northern Thailand, benchmarked loosely against the cheaper tourist areas of Chiang Mai and the Old City. Pai is smaller and more rural than Chiang Mai, with a similar cafe and bar scene but fewer mid-range hotels. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local relationship to the beer anchor (roughly 2x and 3x) because direct knowledge is weak.
